back_text: Step into a playful world of stitched plushie monsters, sleepy little ghosts, friendly bats, and cosy moonlit rooms. Every illustration is 100% original and drawn with thick, clean outlines.
Designed in the popular bold-and-easy cosy style, these 50 single-sided pages give you big, relaxing shapes to colour with alcohol markers, gel pens, or coloured pencils.
Single-sided pages with blank backs help prevent bleed-through — perfect for teens, adults, and older kids who love spooky-cute aesthetics all year round.

description_html:
50 original spooky-cute plushie monsters and cosy haunted scenes!

Love cute-but-creepy characters? This bold-and-easy colouring book is packed with stitched plushie critters, friendly ghosts, potion shops, and cosy autumn nights.

  • 50 single-sided pages (blank backs to help prevent marker bleed-through)
  • Thick, bold outlines and clean spaces — satisfying for markers, gel pens, and pencils
  • Original stitched plushies, cyclops critters, tea-drinking ghosts, witchy cats, and cosy spooky rooms
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch format

A fun, relaxing gift for teens, adults, and older kids who love spooky-cute vibes all year round.
cover_prompt: An original, adorable spooky-cute group of friends in a cosy moonlit pumpkin patch: a fluffy smiling teal stitched plushie monster with button eyes, a friendly little white ghost holding hot cocoa, a cute purple one-eyed cyclops critter with a bow tie, a smiling black cat in a witch hat, and a happy little bat.
